nodes.description: Address with administrative privileges; set in constructor to msg.sender and mutable via changeOwner.
Address permitted to pause/resume the game and change owner; set from ZTHBANKROLL and mutable via changeBankroll.
Boolean flag gating whether spins are allowed; toggled by pauseGame/resumeGame.
Address of the external jackpot holding contract; used for payOutWinner and getJackpot calls.
Per-divRate tracked token balance used to compute max profit and validate bets.
Numerator (out of maxProfitDivisor) controlling the max profit percentage.
Mapping of player address to pending playerSpin struct holding tokenValue, blockn, tier and divRate.
Cumulative spin counter incremented with unchecked addition.

Mapping marking addresses as legitimate bankrolls; used by the fromBankroll modifier.
Hardcoded ZethrInterface instance used to pull dividends via withdraw().
Private settlement routine; resolves a pending spin, computes profit, zeroes the player spin and triggers external token payouts.
Private spin entry point guarded by betIsValid; stores the player spin struct and increments counters.

Owner-only setter of the external jackpot contract address.

Owner-or-bankroll function reassigning the owner address.
Owner-or-bankroll function reassigning the bankroll address.
Transfers the whole ETH balance to the main bankroll address.

Public view computing the per-divRate max profit from contractBalance and maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
Randomness helper deriving a value from blockhash of a past block plus an entropy address.
Internal setup that instantiates Zethr, loads the 7 bankroll addresses and whitelists them.
External jackpot contract function invoked with the winner address during settlement.
External token bankroll function that transfers tokens to a target; called with player-controlled profit.
Caller-controlled address used for auth checks, spin ownership and bankroll validation.
External call to jackpot payOutWinner executed while playerSpins/state still mid-settlement.

External call pulling dividends from the Zethr main contract.
Unchecked increment of totalSpins and totalZTHWagered (0.4.24 wrap-around risk).
Raw (unchecked) multiplication contractBalance*maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse before division.
TKN struct parameter carrying sender and wagered value into _spinTokens.
divRate parameter selecting the tier bankroll and contract balance bucket.
Address parameter indexing playerSpins during _finishSpin settlement.

Computed payout amount derived from spin.tokenValue and the outcome category.
Random outcome value driving the payout branch selection.

edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner before mutating maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
onlyOwner gate on ownerSetMinBet uses caller address.
onlyOwner gate on ownerSetZlotsAddress uses caller address.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll gate on pauseGame depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll gate on resumeGame depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll gate on changeOwner depends on msg.sender.
onlyOwnerOrBankroll gate on changeBankroll depends on msg.sender.
finishSpin settles the spin belonging to msg.sender.
fromBankroll modifier validates msg.sender against ValidBankrollAddress.
execute is restricted to whitelisted bankroll callers.
msg.sender-derived _from flows through execute into _spinTokens as the wagerer address.
_tkn value is stored as the wagered token amount in the player spin struct.
divRate selects the contractBalance bucket used for bet validation.
Locally built spin struct is written into playerSpins[msg.sender].
_spinTokens performs unchecked totalSpins and totalZTHWagered increments.
Unchecked increment of the totalSpins counter state variable.
_spinTokens settles any prior spin by calling _finishSpin.
finishSpin delegates settlement to _finishSpin.
playerSpins[target] is read and rewritten across the settlement flow.
In-memory spin controls tokenValue, blockn, tier and divRate used in settlement.
target parameter indexes playerSpins and is used as the payout recipient.
profit is derived from spin.tokenValue multipliers and divisions.
result branches determine profit, category and events.
tier selects which bankroll address receives the payment request.
profit amount is forwarded into the external bankroll payment.
_finishSpin calls RequestBankrollPayment before/while state is being cleared.
RequestBankrollPayment performs an external token transfer via gameRequestTokens.
External call into the token bankroll with an attacker-relevant target and amount.
_finishSpin calls the jackpot contract during the win branch.
External call to ZlotsJackpotHoldingContract.payOutWinner with the winner address.
Jackpot callback occurs while playerSpins state is being reset, enabling re-entry.
contractBalance feeds the max-profit computation.
betIsValid calls getMaxProfit to bound the wager before _spinTokens proceeds.
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse participates in a raw unchecked multiplication.
contractBalance multiplicand can overflow without SafeMath.
Owner-supplied percentage flows into the unchecked max-profit multiplication.
Setter writes newMaxProfitAsPercent into maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll calls the external Zethr withdraw.
External call into the hardcoded main Zethr contract pulling dividends.
execute forwards the bankroll transfer into _spinTokens.
Constructor bankroll address is passed into setupBankrollInterface.
setupBankrollInterface populates UsedBankrollAddresses from an external contract.
setupBankrollInterface whitelists each bankroll in ValidBankrollAddress.
ValidBankrollAddress controls whether execute is reachable.

normalization_plan.reason: The _tkn parameter is consumed only inside _spinTokens, so it folds into that core function node.
divRate is used solely to index contractBalance and tier lookup inside _spinTokens.
The target parameter exists only to index playerSpins and receive payout inside _finishSpin.
The local spin snapshot is a temporary view of playerSpins handled entirely by _finishSpin.
profit is computed in _finishSpin and immediately passed to the RequestBankrollPayment external payment.
result only drives the branch selection inside _finishSpin.
tier is a transient value forwarded into the external bankroll payment call.
BankrollAddress is used only to bootstrap the bankroll interface during setup.
